newsitem.title: USA: Duckwall-ALCO Stores sells 1.3 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Duckwall-ALCO Stores sells 1.3 mln shrs.

text.p: Duckwall-ALCO Stores Inc said it sold about 1.3 million shares of common stock, of which 900,000 shares were offered by Duckwall-ALCO and 360,000 shares offered by certain stockholders of the company.
The shares were priced at $13 each, the company said.

Proceeds of the offering will be used to fund the opening of new stores, the retailer said, adding that pending this use, the company intends to use the net proceeds to repay indebtedness under its revolving loan facility.

The underwriters for the offering are Piper Jaffray, Inc, The Robinson-Humphrey Co, Inc and Stifel, Nicolaus & Co. The underwriters have the option to purchase an additional 189,000 shares to cover over-allotments, the company said, adding that after the offering, Duckwall-ALCO will have 4.9 million shares outstanding, exclusive of any shares that may be sold to cover over-allotments.
